summary: First-iteration testing of CampusCrave (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/register/me, bad-token 401, role selection, 409 duplicate), menu (available flag = in_stock AND within_time_window), slots (16 slots 11:00-15:00, status OPEN/FILLING/FULL, remaining), orders (server-side pricing, student-owned 403, concurrency: 10 parallel POSTs against capacity=3 -> only 3 succeed, 7x409, no overbooking; unavailable item -> 409; full slot -> 409), kitchen (list sorted by slot_start_min, batch aggregate, PATCH status advance), stock toggle by kitchen/admin (item then unavailable in /api/menu), admin menu CRUD (soft-delete removes from list), analytics (all keys present), role enforcement (student -> 403 on kitchen/admin routes). Frontend: student login lands on /menu, added item, opened checkout, saw 16 slots, selected slot + UPI + Pay & Confirm, redirected to /order/{id} with pickup token 'CC-3417-A653' and QR rendered; My Orders shows 7 cards. Kitchen login lands on /queue with 7 tickets + Batch Prep aggregate; advance button flipped PLACED->PREPARING and Undo bar appeared; Stock tab shows 12 rows. Admin login lands on /dashboard analytics (Revenue Rs.880, 7 orders, avg 125.71, peak intervals, top sellers); Menu tab 12 rows; Slots tab 16 config rows with +/- capacity working. No red screens, no page errors. Only console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (react-native-web) - cosmetic, non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: React-native-web warning 'shadow*' style props are deprecated - use boxShadow. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow or use Platform.select. Reference: repeated console warning on every navigation.

action_items: (Optional) Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow (or use Platform-guarded style) to silence RN-Web warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI - consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking).
server.py: seed_data always runs on every startup; idempotent but slower boot on cold starts (acceptable for demo).
server.py file is ~640 lines - approaching the 700-line guideline; if it grows, split routes into modules (auth/menu/orders/admin).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for critical flows tested (student order, kitchen advance/undo, admin analytics/menu/slots)

seed_data_creation: No seed data manually created; tests reused server-seeded demo users and menu. A few TEST_ users were auto-registered during tests (prefixed for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 24 cases). Concurrency test sets capacity=3 on a fresh slot and fires 10 parallel POSTs - keep this in the suite. Note that after running, several slots have booked > 0 and some may have modified capacity; analytics counters reflect these test orders. Demo users are seeded via startup.
rca_of_issue: No bugs. All targeted features from the review request are functional end-to-end.
